title: Addendum No. 1 to RFP-2026-014
paragraphs: This addendum forms part of RFP-2026-014 (Orion Enterprise Cloud Modernization Program). It responds to vendor questions received before 9 October 2026. All other requirements remain unchanged.
Requirement 4.11 is amended to read: The platform must retain audit logs of all administrative actions for at least 24 months.
Requirement 9.7 is amended to read: Describe planned maintenance notification periods, blackout-window options, and how emergency maintenance is communicated.
New requirement 5.9: Describe your approach to cloud cost reporting and chargeback per business unit.
New requirement 6.13: Confirm that all support staff with access to customer data are located in the EU or North America.
The submission deadline in requirement 2.1 is unchanged.
